title: Request inspector: full detail with headers and body
description: Implement request detail view in app.js. Show full request with summary, headers table, body display with base64 decoding, JSON pretty-printing, binary payload detection, copy buttons.
acceptance_criteria: Summary shows method badge, path, source IP, timestamp
Headers displayed as key-value table in monospace
Body: decode base64, auto-detect JSON for pretty-print
Binary payloads show '(binary payload, N bytes)'
Copy buttons for headers and body
